name: Tactiq
tagline: Tactiq is a Chrome extension that transcribes meetings in real time on Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams, then uses AI to generate summaries and action items. Unlike recording-based tools, Tactiq captures captions as they appear without recording the meeting, making it useful in privacy-sensitive organisations.
